text: Implied take rate is revenue divided by GBV. Revenue timing follows stays and experiences while bookings enter GBV when booked. It does not identify a contractual fee rate. EBITDA margin uses revenue, and FCF margin uses same-period revenue. TTM margins use the four-quarter sum of both numerator and denominator.

text: Quarter FCF equals operating cash less property purchases. Trailing twelve months is the latest four quarters, not four times the latest quarter. Booking seasonality makes quarterly and TTM liquidity rates different. Customer funds do not enter FCF except interest earned on them.
